howToPlay: Use your basic attack to mark targets and trigger extra damage by hitting them again or using the Hacks gadget. When in need, use the Out Of Line gadget to charge your Super instantly, or stay protected while split with the Recording star power.
gears: Equip Damage to maximize output, Shield to compensate for health, and Gadget Cooldown to frequently trigger your unique abilities.
trait: This brawler is ideal for tactical players who enjoy precision-based marksmanship and controlling the battlefield through calculated ability combos.
